content: The enzyme CYP3A4 plays a critical role in the metabolism of tinidazole, and its activity can be influenced by various drugs. 1. Rifapentine reduces the levels or effects of tinidazole by inducing hepatic and intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution is advised, and monitoring is recommended. 2. Risperidone increases the levels or effects of tinidazole by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 3. Ritonavir significantly increases the levels or effects of tinidazole by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and close monitoring are necessary. 4. Rucaparib increases the levels or effects of tinidazole by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Dosage adjustments of CYP3A4 substrates may be required if clinically indicated. 5. Rufinamide increases the levels or effects of tinidazole by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 6. Schisandra increases the levels or effects of tinidazole by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 7. Stiripentol is both a CYP3A4 inhibitor and inducer, which can either increase or decrease the effects of tinidazole. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. Dosage adjustments of CYP3A4 substrates may be necessary. 12. Sulconazole increases the levels or effects of tinidazole by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 13.
